confounds: /effort ultracode combines xhigh reasoning effort with automatic workflow orchestration in one switch. A run launched that way is confounded and is not evidence that orchestration alone improved quality. Pin effort identically across arms and opt in by keyword or saved-command name instead.
An organization availableModels allowlist can substitute a workflow agent's model. None is configured on the inspected machine, but effective models stay null/unverified until a real run is observed.

notes: Graph candidate driven by adapters/claude_workflow. The worker, attempt and elapsed-time budgets are labelled `enforced` because the bench-controlled run() really stops them and reaps owned subprocesses on timeout; they are enforced only on the adapter path, not on a manual launch. Token and cost budgets are `unavailable`: the native workflow runtime exposes no token or cost ceiling - its large-run warning is explicitly advisory and does not pause or limit a run. Stays configured:false until the operator records the models, the effort setting and the live run command; do not treat it as configured.
